description: This file defines the OpenAiCompatibleResponsesHandler class, which manages interactions with OpenAI's API for generating responses, including handling streaming responses, constructing request bodies, and managing different API configurations (standard, Azure, Azure Inference). It also includes methods for processing events and normalizing usage data.

classes.name: OpenAiCompatibleResponsesHandler
classes.description: A class that handles communication with OpenAI's API, supporting different deployment configurations (standard, Azure, Azure Inference), managing streaming responses, constructing request payloads, and processing response events.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Generates a message stream based on system prompt, messages, and optional metadata.

methods.name: handleResponsesApiMessage
methods.description: Handles the API message creation process, including formatting conversation and building request body.

methods.name: buildRequestBody
methods.description: Constructs the request payload for the responses API based on model, conversation, and options.

methods.name: executeRequest
methods.description: Executes the API request, manages streaming response, and handles errors.

methods.name: formatFullConversation
methods.description: Formats messages into the structure expected by the API, including handling different message types and roles.

methods.name: makeResponsesApiRequest
methods.description: Fallback method to make a direct fetch request to the Responses API endpoint.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Processes individual response events, yielding appropriate chunks based on event type.

methods.name: normalizeUsage
methods.description: Normalizes usage data from API responses to a standard format.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model configuration, including default and custom info.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt by sending it to the API and returning the generated text.

methods.name: _getUrlHost
methods.description: Extracts the host part from a URL string.

methods.name: _isAzureAiInference
methods.description: Determines if the URL points to an Azure AI inference endpoint.
